name: Douzhanopterus
isnote: Recovered between wukongopterids and Pterodactyloidea (Wang et al. 2017); not assigned to any family.
sum: Transitional monofenestratan from the Late Jurassic of Liaoning, China, with a tail of intermediate length.
holotype: STM 19-35 — Tiaojishan Formation, Linglongta, Liaoning (Shandong Tianyu Museum).
material: Skeleton lacking the skull, on plate and counterplate.
biology: Small, adult individual; ecology not specifically studied.
author: Wang et al. 2017

species.name: Douzhanopterus zhengi
species.author: Wang et al. 2017
